plan.notes: Source: official NC State University Undergraduate Catalog, Computer Science (BS) degree page, https://catalog.ncsu.edu/undergraduate/engineering/computer-science/computer-science-bs/, retrieved 2026-09-30. Catalog year 2026-2027: the live (non-archived) catalog; NC State's catalog archives already contain 2025-2026, and this edition includes the new Applied AI courses (CSC 201, CSC 301) absent from the 2024-2025 edition. Transcription method: the 'Semester Sequence' Plan of Study Grid was transcribed verbatim term-by-term; course codes/titles are verbatim from the official page. Elective slots (CSC Restricted Elective 12 hrs total, Other Restricted Electives - Group A 6 hrs, Group B 6 hrs, GEP Requirement, GEP Health and Exercise Studies 2 hrs) are choice slots whose full option lists live in the catalog (not enumerated here). The official page does not list per-course prerequisites in the sequence, so prereq arrays are empty and external_prereqs is empty. Grade footnotes: (1) grade of C or higher required (CH 101 & CH 102, MA 141, MA 241, PY 205, CSC 116, CSC 216 & CSC 217, CSC 226); (2) grade of C- or higher required (E 101, E 102, ENG 101, CSC 201); (3) major GPA rule: the major GPA (all CSC courses attempted at NC State) must be 2.0 or higher, or the student may graduate if no CSC course used to satisfy major requirements has a grade below C-. Caveats: the catalog labels the sequence 'This is a sample.' Students enter the CS major via the CODA process after the engineering first year. The program is accredited by the Computing Accreditation Commission of ABET.
